title: RULED BY THE REPRESENTATION SPACE: ON THE UNIVERSITY’S EMBRACE OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Critical theoretical evaluation of how model alignment, fine-tuning, and training data curation embed specific political ideologies (e.g., Silicon Valley tech sector or Chinese state ideology).

Philosophical critique utilizing feminist and postcolonial studies to evaluate how generative AI models obfuscate positional and situated knowledge by imposing domain-non-specific norms and claiming neutrality.
